text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking along the riverbank,
I heard lively voices coming from behind me.

text_block_list.name: The Five
text_block_list.text: Rock, paper, scissors, shoot!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, everyone's rock.
Except El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gah! Urgh... I won't lose at the next streetlamp!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, King, hand over your luggage!
I shall carry it for you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Finally freed...!
Heh, El. Once you lose this match--

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
And so, King broke free from the negative loop
of luggage-carrying rock-paper-scissors.
Unfortunately, at the next streetlight...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
Don't say such ominous things!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“Once we haul this luggage back to the dorm,
we're having a carrot party with everyone!”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm so glad it cleared up today~.
Eating carrot sticks outside is going to be so exquisite~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Still though, the only ones left who haven't lost at rock-paper-scissors yet are Spe-chan and Grass-chan, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my. Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Well then, Spe-chan.
Shall the two of us settle the score next?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!? G-Grass-chan...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Geez, all four of you are so slow, desu!
El has already made it to the streetlight-yo~!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Spe-chan.
I shall be on my way too...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Grass-chan!?
So fast... Wait for meee~!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...And so? Sky-san.
Did you instigate Grass-san on purpose?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"No, no~ Who knows~?
I just noticed that not everyone was
carrying luggage, that's all~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, no matter which of them wins next time,
I'm sure the winner of the race after that
will carry my luggage for me."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Is that your strategy?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. It's about trust.
I mean, they're all good kids, right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*.
You really are something...
